_comment: The write-amplification count: each writer the engine tallies, left out in turn. tests/test_stats.cpp checks the engine's count of what it wrote against the simulated disk's count of what was appended, by kind of file, so a writer that stops counting is a mismatch rather than a smaller number nobody questions. The per-level split in ambar.stats is the same counters again by level and is not checked separately.
